Are you an experienced Chef looking for regular work within schools & DBS Catering?

FIRE Group Recruitment is currently recruiting Chefs of all levels, including Chef de Partie, Sous Chefs and Head Chefs, to support several school catering operations & DBS Catering across the Southern Region

Interested? Message us directly with your experience, location and availability.

job.title: Pastry Chef
job.description:
Pastry Chef
Up to £40,000 + Service Charge & Excellent Benefits
New Forest, Hampshire 
 
The Role
 
Our client, a highly regarded multiple Rosette restaurant operation, based in the New Forest, is looking for a passionate and creative Pastry Chef to join their established and talented kitchen team.
 
This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Pastry Chef/Head Pastry Chef to take responsibility for the pastry section within a quality operation, producing exceptional plated desserts, afternoon teas and pastry work using fresh, seasonal produce.
 
Working closely with the Executive Chef, you will have genuine creative input into the menus, with the opportunity to develop new ideas and put your own stamp on the pastry offering.
 
The kitchen is modern, spacious and exceptionally well equipped, providing an excellent environment in which to work.
 
About You
 
We are looking for a Pastry Chef with a strong background in a high-end restaurant or hotel environment, with multiple Rosette experience, who is passionate about their craft and takes real pride in producing exceptional pastry.

You will ideally:
  • Have strong experience leading a pastry section within a high quality restaurant or hotel
  • Have excellent plated dessert experience
  • Have strong pastry skills and chocolate work experience
  • Be creative, with a genuine interest in developing new desserts and ideas
  • Have excellent attention to detail and high standards of presentation
  • Be organised, clean and tidy in your approach
  • Have a good understanding of allergens and food safety
  • Be a confident communicator and a strong team player
  • Be passionate, motivated and enthusiastic about your trade
  • Enjoy developing junior members of the team
  • Be keen to grow and develop within the business
This is a great opportunity for a talented and experienced Pastry Chef / Head Pastry Chef who wants more than simply producing an established menu. You will have the opportunity to work closely with an experienced Executive Chef, contribute your own ideas and help shape the future pastry offering.
 
What's on Offer?
  • Up to £40,000 salary
  • £300-£400 per month service charge
  • Free parking
  • Staff meals
  • Various company discounts
  • Modern, well-equipped kitchen
  • Excellent working environment
  • Genuine opportunity for career development
  • Creative input into menus 
Due to the location, applicants will need their own transport.
 
If you are an experienced Pastry Chef looking for a new challenge within a quality multiple Rosette operation, where your creativity and ideas will be valued, this could be an excellent opportunity for you!

job.title: Chef
job.description:
A fantastic opportunity for a skilled Chef looking for a great work-life balance!

Our client is a prestigious school near Winchester, Hampshire, with an exceptional catering operation. With a dedicated team of professional staff across the catering operation serving pupils and staff —the school prides itself on producing fresh, nutritious, high-quality food every day. As well as the day to day catering, they also cater for a variety of events and functions. They are currently looking to recruit a skilled and passionate lead Chef to join their team.
 
The Role
 
You will play a key role in preparing daily meals for pupils and staff -
producing everything fresh on site—hot dishes, salads, pastry items, cakes, desserts, and traybakes. You will also assist with hospitality and event catering. As the lead Chef you will be expected to run a shift independently, catering for around 80 per day, ensuring high standards across all areas of the kitchen. The role also involves supporting school events such as functions, afternoon teas, receptions, and special occasions. You'll work closely with the Head Chef and another Chef on a rotating shift pattern.      

Hours of work

Contract: Permanent - 52 week contract
Hours: 40 hours per week
Shift Times: An 8 hour shift between the hours of 6:30am and 7:30pm. Straight shifts. No Late Nights!

Pay & Benefits
This Chef position offers a good hourly rate, great work life balance + excellent benefits including:
  • Free use of onsite gym
  • Free uniform
  • Free parking
  • Meal provided on duty
  • Pension scheme
  • Training & development opportunities
  • Discounts on shopping, cinema tickets, clothing, technology, utilities, family activities, and holidays
  • Flexible working options
  • Additional leave purchase
  • Recognition and awards programmes
  • Employee assistance programme
  • Health & wellbeing support
  • Health cash plan
  • Life assurance
....and much more!
 
Person Specification: Essential:
  • Strong High level cooking ability with experience across all kitchen sections, including pastry
  • Confident producing a high standard of fresh food at volume
  • Ability to run a kitchen shift independently
  • Experience working within an independent school environment ideally
  • Experience catering for events and functions
  • Solid knowledge of food hygiene, due diligence, and compliance standards
  • Reliable, organised, and comfortable working in a busy, varied environment
If you are a talented chef with previous experience cooking to a high standard at volume, looking to work with fresh produce and have a great work life balance, then this could be the perfect chef role for you! Please get in touch or apply for further information. 

*We are also looking for a chef on a term time contract, if you are looking for a term time only chef role, then please do get in touch also*
